question_text: Describe how ROLLBACK can restore a consistent state when an unfinished transfer has debited one account but has not credited the other.
adaptation_rationale: Replaces unrestricted database recovery methods with explicitly required transaction rollback.
solution: ROLLBACK undoes the uncommitted debit and other changes of that transaction. Both accounts return to their pre-transaction values, avoiding a half-completed transfer.
